messages.body: Back from the ride. 42 km, no wind, legs felt good. #cycling

Sensor build, where things stand:
- soil probe reads about 410 when dry
- reads about 190 in a wet pot
- logging every 10 minutes to one SQLite file
- next up is a box for the board #sensor #garden

Dinner was the lentil stew again. Added smoked paprika this time. The recipe lives only in my head so far. #cooking

- rain jacket
